name: member.get_savings_balance
description: Get the savings balance for member {member_id}

member_id.source: Module 1 member search accepts exact 5-digit IDs only (D-033 E-11; message "Enter a valid 5-digit member ID.")

savings_balance.description: Amount shown as "Balance" in the "Savings Account" section.

target.why: Found by role and accessible name (textbox "Username"), which is the same for every member, inside the "Employee Sign In" section so a same-named control elsewhere cannot match. Must match exactly one element; the fallback drops the section and must also match exactly one.

Found by role and accessible name (textbox "Password"), which is the same for every member, inside the "Employee Sign In" section so a same-named control elsewhere cannot match. Must match exactly one element; the fallback drops the section and must also match exactly one.

Found by role and accessible name (button "Sign In"), which is the same for every member, inside the "Employee Sign In" section so a same-named control elsewhere cannot match. Must match exactly one element; the fallback drops the section and must also match exactly one.

Found by role and accessible name (textbox "Member ID"), which is the same for every member, inside the "Member Search" section so a same-named control elsewhere cannot match. Must match exactly one element; the fallback drops the section and must also match exactly one.

Found by role and accessible name (button "Search"), which is the same for every member, inside the "Member Search" section so a same-named control elsewhere cannot match. Must match exactly one element; the fallback drops the section and must also match exactly one.

Found by role and accessible name (button "Savings Account"), which is the same for every member, inside the "Member Details" section so a same-named control elsewhere cannot match. Must match exactly one element; the fallback drops the section and must also match exactly one.

Found by the label "Balance" inside the "Savings Account" section. The value itself differs per member, so it is never used to find the element. Must match exactly one element; the fallback drops the section and must also match exactly one.
